review_comment: The gcov-exec option is used directly in command construction without proper shell escaping, creating a command injection vulnerability. The validator.escape() function does not provide adequate protection against OS command injection as it's designed for HTML/SQL contexts. Use proper shell argument escaping or parameterization to prevent command injection.

The gcov-args input from user options is escaped with validator.escape() but then directly concatenated into a shell command. This creates a command injection vulnerability because HTML escaping does not protect against shell metacharacters. The fix requires using proper shell escaping or parameterization of the command arguments.
